name: s3Upload
syntax: s3Upload(bucketName, objectName, source [, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Uploads a file to an S3 bucket.

params.name: source
params.description: A file path, or a file object from `fileOpen()`.

params.name: acl
params.description: An array of structs, one for each ACL grant.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Detects the MIME type from the object key's extension. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Upload a local file
examples.description: Reads the local file and stores it in the bucket.
